name: Sidney Black
source:
A black rabbit that hates the protagonist.
He's always nervous and irritated. He hates the color white and wants to paint everything black.
He's bad with the Diamond Queen who loves white, but he serves her loyally as the Prime Minister of the Diamond Castle.
When the stress makes his hair turn white he gets even more stressed.
